capabilities: Render latex code blocks into inline SVG images
Configure a custom shell command that converts .tex input to .svg output
Cache generated SVG files and reuse them across notes
Style rendered output with CSS snippets via the block-language-latex class
extras: Requires a locally installed TeX distribution and a user-supplied compile command; the README notes the cross-device sync behavior of the SVG cache "hasn't been tested" and gives troubleshooting for PATH and ghostscript issues.
intentEvidence: This project is a fork of an existing plugin repository
motivation: The author forked an unpublished plugin because its original author had moved on, and built a version that "more closely aligned with my use cases and objectives."
problem: Obsidian's built-in math rendering can't compile full latex documents or use arbitrary packages, so some snippets need a real latex toolchain.

relations.evidence: Thanks to fenjalien who created the original

summary: Latex code-block renderer that compiles snippets with a user-configured external latex command and displays the resulting SVG inline.
